findings.statement: The RS078 common pair carriers are scalar-inexact after assembly: Cartesian contradictions0/38/7 and feasible0/1/7 in training order. All original PMEC and separated controls reproduce individual exactness. This excludes coarser common pair partitions only on the same source domain and assembly.

The original PMEC common observed-triangle quotient fails on6x3-k4, while per-carrier V/(sum ker F_i) has ranks72/249/13 and preserves scalar images. Common-linear preservation follows if the scalar map factors each F_i; this is a conditional theorem, not a closed evaluator.

Restricting common triangle closure to each carrier domain restores individual exactness at ranks72/248/12. Pooled equality paths add a scalar-bearing defect on6x3-k4. Domain choice is part of the map.

Individual exactness does not imply one pooled functional. Original separated pooled rows315(4x5 local240) and455(6x3-k4 local9) are identical with scalar XOR2, excluding even a nonlinear decoder of those rows. Support-profile and geometry-tagged repairs add empirical context and are not common quotients of the unaugmented maps.

Pooling the13-map compression lineage first loses exactness at role/depth compression. Earlier exact/sign/signed-parity maps pool exactly; later failures have scalar-kernel image{0,2}, preserving only the matched-dependency draw character.
In the12-map pooled grid, C role removal does not change the result; exact D depth passes, while parity and depthless D fail for SIGN and SIGNED_PARITY. Old individual qualifications remain valid.

A geometry-free native repair exists: SIGNED_PARITY with zero-versus-positive depth and separated owners has pooled rank353 and exactness. The corresponding SIGN map fails. Minimal passing index modes are relative to the frozen index/encoding grid.

Owner-separated frontier tags repair PMEC03/04 at rank349 and separated saturation at350; anonymous frontier tags do not. PMEC01/02 remain inexact. This does not establish universal frontier-owner necessity.

All8 within-pair invariant-correlation subsets and the complete unordered owner-vector map fail pooled transfer, while the ordered-owner source passes. Their obstruction is the win character; this is a pair-level owner quotient.

Coherent formal triangle owner exchange still fails at rank346 with kernel image{0,2}. Regenerating endpoint orientation from owner-swapped vertices is a different map and loses both characters at rank277. Neither result proves a game-symmetry impossibility.

Seven of36 zero/bulk summary maps pool exactly; six have rank352 and the ordered control353. Either frontier owner labels with unordered bulk sign marginals, or bulk owner labels with frontier TOTAL/ABS_NET, can preserve exactness. All25 maps retaining both nonconstant strata preserve the draw character; removing either stratum loses all nonzero characters.

On970 observed selected triangles, the finest common partition of those7 successful maps has756 classes and pooled rank351. Its111-dimensional dependency kernel equals the common-linear kernel. This is finite domain-qualified exactness, not a universal native formula.

The observed source projects to817 record triangles. Closing frontier, bulk, or both formal owner swaps gives1488/1478/2547 records and pooled ranks345/346/345; each extension introduces one win-character contradiction and preserves draw. Added records receive no scalar labels.

On a symbol domain closed under commuting frontier and bulk owner swaps, a common factor of all7 RS089 maps identifies both operations and their composition. RS088 formal-owner obstruction therefore rules out scalar descent to that common factor. The result is conditional on the declared symbol domain, not legal-triangle realizability.

All scalar results use the same462 aligned training dependencies in fixed loss00/draw01/win10 gauge. No coefficients or per-state exceptions were fitted. Candidate catalogs, rows and bases were committed before their new replay; later families may be transparently motivated by completed earlier training results. Q_F/Q_A, BSFP and authority1.2 are unchanged; both formula holdouts remain sealed.
